description: Confirms the signup email with the eight-digit code the person received. Codes expire after 15 minutes and allow five attempts. Keep the returned capability and continuationToken private. Does not activate insurance.

inputSchema.description: Confirms the signup email with the emailed code.

code.description: The eight-digit code from the verification email. Valid for 15 minutes, five attempts.

name: verify_onboarding_email

capability.description: Secret proof of this signup. Keep it private and send it with onboardingId.

continuationToken.description: Secret token for /payment-handoff, valid for 15 minutes after verification.

policyIds.description: IDs of the offered policies, once created.

state.description: awaiting_verification: ask the person for the emailed code; email_confirmed: call /verify-email again to finish; verified: offers are ready.

title: Confirm the signup email
